ponant.name: The Ponant
ponant.description: The western continent, from the ridges of the Fangs of Varn to the cliffs of the Bastion. A land of old kingdoms, sacred forests and wheat valleys.

levant.name: The Levant
levant.description: The eastern continent: taiga and foundries in the north, ochre sands in the south, and between them the Ether Wastes that nobody rules.

givrecroc.name: Frostfang
givrecroc.description: An ice island north of the Sea of Mists. Its clans live off seals, whales and the tunnels dug through the glacier.

brisants.name: Breakers Archipelago
brisants.description: A string of tropical islands ringed by reefs. Wrecks outnumber harbours here.

braise.name: Ember Island
braise.description: A volcanic island in the southeast, dominated by the Ember-Heart. Its basalt slopes yield the finest black glass in the known world.

guet.name: Watch Island
guet.description: A fortified rock in the middle of the Opal Sea. A watchtower guards the straits between the two continents.

aubemont.name: Kingdom of Aubemont
aubemont.description: A Ponant kingdom ruled from the Bastion. Its blue-and-gold banners fly from the Velde to the Dead Waters.

ysmera.name: Domain of Ysmera
ysmera.description: A sylvan protectorate around the World Tree. No tree is felled there without the Sylvan Wardens' consent.

nordhal.name: Confederation of Nordhal
nordhal.description: A league of cities in the Levant's north, linked by the Ether Line. Coal, iron and technomancy.

orsalis.name: Hegemony of Orsalis
orsalis.description: A merchant empire of the sands, from Kheranne to the Maëlis coast. It holds the caravan roads and taxes the ether that travels them.

givreclans.name: Clans of Frostfang
givreclans.description: Seven clans that gather every winter in the Hall of Wintering.

libre-port.name: Free Port of Corsaille
libre-port.description: A free city of the Breakers ruled by a council of captains. Everything is for sale, especially what was stolen.

cite-etat-aerolys.name: City-State of Aérolys
cite-etat-aerolys.description: The city that floats above the Opal Sea, carried by ether crystals. It only touches the ground through its airships.

comte-bastion.name: County of the Bastion
comte-bastion.description: Crown lands around the capital: cliffs, orchards and the villas of the great houses.

velde.name: Duchy of Velde
velde.description: The kingdom's granary, a valley of wheat and windmills crossed by the Velde.

marche-de-varn.name: March of Varn
marche-de-varn.description: A mountain border march held by mining barons and the fortress of Mistfort.

mortes.name: Barony of the Dead Waters
mortes.description: A swampy barony the crown controls mostly on paper.

pays-de-pierrelune.name: Moonstone Country
pays-de-pierrelune.description: The southwest coast, fishing villages and wind-beaten chapels.

coeur-sylve.name: Sylvan Heart
coeur-sylve.description: The sanctuary around the World Tree, closed to axes and wagons.

lisieres.name: Fringes of Ysmera
lisieres.description: The Domain's outer woods, patrolled by the Sylvan Wardens.

plaine-ferratre.name: Ironhearth Plain
plaine-ferratre.description: An industrial plain around the capital, covered with slag heaps and railways.

givre-bleu.name: Bluefrost Marches
givre-bleu.description: Conifer forests and logging camps in the northeast.

hautes-echines.name: High Spines
hautes-echines.description: Mining highlands at the foot of the Purple Spines.

vallee-de-kheranne.name: Kheranne Valley
vallee-de-kheranne.description: Oases, palm groves and canals around the Hegemony's capital.

ocre.name: Satrapy of the Sands
ocre.description: A desert of dunes and mesas, crossed by the Caravan Road and the Ether Line.

cote-de-maelis.name: Maëlis Coast
cote-de-maelis.description: A jungle coast of stilt villages, rich in spices.

marches-pourpres.name: Purple Marches
marches-pourpres.description: The Hegemony's eastern frontier, facing the Ether Wastes.

fjords.name: Wintering Fjords
fjords.description: The island's south coast, where the fjords stay free of ice in summer.

cimes.name: White Peaks
cimes.description: The island's frozen heart, under the glacier.

ile-corsaille.name: Corsaille Island
ile-corsaille.description: The Free Port's mother island, its roadstead and coves.

bastion.name: The Bastion
bastion.description: Capital of Aubemont, perched on the white cliffs above the Opal Sea. Its citadel, arena and aqueducts can be seen from leagues out at sea.

ferratre.name: Ironhearth
ferratre.description: Capital of Nordhal, a city of forges and chimneys where every track of the Ether Line meets.

kheranne.description: Capital of the Hegemony, a city of domes and hanging gardens between desert and sea.

corsaille.description: The Free Port: wooden quays, taverns and flags of every nation.

vellune.description: Market town of the Velde, its windmills and great grain fair.

brumefort.name: Mistfort
brumefort.description: The fortress of the Mist Pass, guarding the only wagon road through the Fangs.

hivernage.name: Wintering
hivernage.description: The clans' harbour, longhouses and longship yards at the head of the fjord.

sombreval.name: Darkvale
sombreval.description: A woodcutters' hamlet at the edge of the Sylve, the last shelter before the World Tree.

gue.name: Willow Ford
gue.description: A village at the ford of the Velde, known for its inn and willows.

pierrelune.name: Moonstone
pierrelune.description: A southwestern fishing port and its Moon chapel.

varn.description: A mining village clinging to the Fangs, above the moonsilver galleries.

ecume.name: Foam Port
ecume.description: A fishing port on the Levant's west coast, end of the branch line.

myr.name: Oasis of Myr
myr.description: A desert oasis where caravans stop, around a jade-coloured lake.

maelis.description: A stilt village at the mouth of the jungle.

cendrelieu.name: Cinderstead
cendrelieu.description: A glassblowers' hamlet at the foot of the volcano.

sylve.name: The Sylve of Ysmera
sylve.description: The oldest forest of the Ponant. Its oaks are the size of towers and the World Tree grows at its centre.

myxe.name: Myxe Wood
myxe.description: A wood of giant mushrooms and glowing moss. The myxo harvested here goes into catalyst crafting.

crocs.name: The Fangs of Varn
crocs.description: A range of peaks closing the Ponant to the west. A single wagon pass, guarded by Mistfort.

echines.name: The Purple Spines
echines.description: Mountains of violet-tinged rock, saturated with ether. Nordhal's mines have dug into them for two centuries.

mortes-eaux.name: The Dead Waters
mortes-eaux.description: Misty marshes in the south of the Ponant. Maps get it wrong, and so do guides.

val-velde.name: Vale of Velde
val-velde.description: A cultivated valley of wheat, barley and lavender, dotted with windmills.

sables.name: The Ochre Sands
sables.description: The great desert of the southern Levant. Its dunes advance a few steps every year.

orgues.name: The Red Organs
orgues.description: Red sandstone mesas carved by the wind. Caravans go around them; raiders live in them.

friches.name: The Ether Wastes
friches.description: A plateau of crystals and glowing rifts where ether rises to the surface. No nation holds it for more than a season.

forets-du-givre-bleu.name: Bluefrost Forests
forets-du-givre-bleu.description: Endless taiga in the north of the Levant, where the Ether Line's sleepers are cut.

jungle-maelis.name: Maëlis Jungle
jungle-maelis.description: Thick jungle on the east coast, its muddy rivers and swallowed temples.

glacier.name: Frostfang Glacier
glacier.description: An ice cap covering the north of the island. Ancient tunnels run through it.

recif.name: Breakers Reef
recif.description: A coral barrier that has broken more hulls than every storm combined.

mont-coeur-de-braise.name: Mount Ember-Heart
mont-coeur-de-braise.description: An active volcano. Its flows reach the sea in years of great eruptions.

miroir.name: Mirror Lake
miroir.description: A great highland lake fed by the Velde. On calm days, they say you can see the stars at noon.

ocean-du-ponant.name: Ponant Ocean
ocean-du-ponant.description: The western ocean, whose far shore nobody has found.

opale.name: Opal Sea
opale.description: The inner sea between Ponant and Levant, under the floating city of Aérolys.

brumes.name: Sea of Mists
brumes.description: The cold northern sea, fogbound three days in four.

corail.name: Coral Sea
corail.description: The warm southern sea, turquoise above the reefs.

golfe-braise.name: Ember Gulf
golfe-braise.description: A gulf of lukewarm water, heated by the volcano.

ocean-du-levant.name: Levant Ocean
ocean-du-levant.description: The eastern ocean, the whalers' route out of Nordhal.

eparses.name: Scattered Isles
eparses.description: Floating islands scattered above the Opal Sea and the Fangs since the Great Upheaval.

clairiere.name: Glade of the World Tree
clairiere.description: The ring of roots where pilgrims and druids camp at the foot of the Tree.

dedale.name: The Maze
dedale.description: A natural network of caves and galleries running beneath the west of the known world. The Bastion's cartographers have charted only a third of it.

galeries-varn.name: Varn Galleries
galeries-varn.description: The moonsilver mines, dug over three centuries. The oldest shafts are walled up.

contrebandiers.name: Smugglers' Caves
contrebandiers.description: Sea caves linked to the Bastion cliffs. What cannot pass customs is unloaded here.

bas-bastion.name: The Lower Bastion
bas-bastion.description: Catacombs and carved halls beneath the capital. The kings of Aubemont have rested here for a thousand years.

jardins-spores.name: Spore Gardens
jardins-spores.description: Caverns of giant mushrooms whose spores light up the rock.

coeur-racines.name: Heart of the Roots
coeur-racines.description: The World Tree's first roots, as thick as towers, cross the rock here.

voie-creuse.name: The Hollow Way
voie-creuse.description: An ancient tunnel bored beneath the Opal Sea. Nobody knows who dug it; smugglers use it to avoid customs.

haltes-de-la-voie-creuse.name: Hollow Way Halts
haltes-de-la-voie-creuse.description: The caverns where travellers stop along the Hollow Way.

veines-ether.name: The Ether Veins
veines-ether.description: Ether-saturated fissures beneath the eastern Levant. Prospectors descend on ropes.

cavernes-cristal.name: Crystal Caverns
cavernes-cristal.description: Halls lined with ether crystals that pulse like a heart.

salle-givre.name: Hall of Frost
salle-givre.description: Blue-ice tunnels under the Frostfang ice cap.

repaire.name: Great Lair
repaire.description: The lair of the Red Organs raiders.

tube-ardent.name: Burning Tube
tube-ardent.description: Cooled lava tubes under Ember Island. Some are not cooled.

trefonds.name: The Depths
trefonds.description: The world beneath the world: caverns as large as counties, sunless seas and dwarven realms. Its borders follow none of the surface's.

dolmhir.description: A dwarven city carved in granite, twelve hundred metres beneath the Fangs. Its forges never go out.

mer-sans-soleil.name: Sunless Sea
mer-sans-soleil.description: An underground lake so vast its far shore cannot be seen. Lantern boats cross it in three days.

labyrinthe-de-seve.name: Labyrinth of Sap
labyrinthe-de-seve.description: A maze of living roots, deeper than the Mother-Roots. The sap glows like amber.

abysses-de-cristal.name: Crystal Abyss
abysses-de-cristal.description: A chasm of giant crystals. The Wastes' ether seeps up from here drop by drop.

braises.name: The Deep Embers
braises.description: The Ember-Heart's magma chamber and the forges that live off it.

chambre-braise.name: Ember Chamber
chambre-braise.description: Salamander forges built on the edge of the magma.

cryptes-englouties.name: Sunken Crypts
cryptes-englouties.description: Temples of a forgotten people, beneath the floor of the Coral Sea.

cite-aerolys.description: A sky city built on a mountain shard torn from the ground. Its ether crystals hold it a thousand metres up.

eparse-1-ile.name: Heron Isle
eparse-1-ile.description: A floating islet of meadows where ether herons nest.

eparse-2-ile.name: Cascade Isle
eparse-2-ile.description: Its springs pour into the void and fall back as rain on the sea.

eparse-3-ile.name: Recluse's Isle
eparse-3-ile.description: A technomancer hermit lives here alone with his automata.

eparse-4-ile.name: Chained Isle
eparse-4-ile.description: Moored to the seabed by three giant chains that no one forged.

eparse-5-ile.name: Varn Isle
eparse-5-ile.description: A peak fragment torn from the Fangs during the Great Upheaval.
